spec: Execute the ORIGINAL Praxis-native capability praxis_native_evidence_research using the helper source interface only. No stock implementation, API credentials, purchases, external transmission, or scientific decisions. Read only supplied corpus and task-relevant sources; never open qualification-expected.json or heldout-expected.json. Return one JSON receipt matching <praxis-root>/services/praxis45/schemas/praxis_native_evidence_research.schema.json. Record every query, retrieval attempt (including failures), retained source, and material claim; Maximum 3 queries, 6 producer retrieval attempts, 6 retrieval record rows, 8 retained sources, 6 claims, or stricter input limits; checker rereads use transparent totals. Use exact passages, original-byte hashes, locators, source dates or unknown, access timestamps, and read_source/search_result_only basis; keep missingness and coverage explicit. Bounds are validated from receipts AND independent dispatch-bound output evidence and the helper log. The upstream Amplifier Fact Check and Deep Research tools were not executed. Retrieve and record provenance without interpretation or epistemic labels. Read input bindings: [{"path": "/SPECIALIZE/absolute/input", "sha256": "SPECIALIZE_SOURCE_SHA256"}]. Write /SPECIALIZE/absolute/output.json. Read each source once in full within a producing task, cache that result, and use locators afterward; do not turn repeated complete downloads into free operations. Absolute ceiling remains 8 retained / 6 complete retrievals / 3 web discovery queries; six retrieval attempts including failures, three discovery queries, eight retained sources and six claims, or stricter frozen budgets. The helper is the only source interface. Every search/fetch/read/control/passage/find/hash call appends one hash-chained per-Dispatch log entry and prints one PRAXIS-OP nonce marker. fetch acquires and completely reads a public HTTPS original; read completely reads a local original/cache with PDF/HTML extraction. Both count as complete reads and attempts. search counts one discovery attempt, including failure. read/fetch cache the complete extracted text and print a head of at most 600 characters; passage/find use cached text, at most 4,000 characters per call and 60 successful calls per Dispatch; hash is metadata only; neither counts as a complete read. A complete read is full machine extraction into cache, not model inspection. operation_accounting.returned_characters reports per-source unique returned-character coverage derived from log offsets; repeat returns count once. Search parsed output counts as returned text and the raw response is an inspectable pseudo-source.  operation_accounting is DERIVED from the authoritative log and must equal it exactly, including the stage and per-source map; under-report and over-report both refuse. Producer stage=producer, source_reads each exactly one; checker stage=checker, checker_source_reads each at most three. complete_source_reads equals sum(source_reads.values()) for producers or sum(checker_source_reads.values()) for checkers; retrieval_attempts equals complete_source_reads plus the number of failed retrieval rows; web_discovery_queries equals len(queries). All counters are nonnegative integers, never booleans. Both report complete_source_reads, retrieval_attempts (including failures) and web_discovery_queries. Checker reads of frozen producer retained originals/cache use retrieval_kind=retained_reread; they are rereads rather than acquisitions. Total checker rereads are at most three times retained sources; new acquisitions keep all established retrieval/query budgets and frozen corpus confinement. All successful rows and retained provenance bind helper-log original-byte SHA256. No native web tools or any other source interface are permitted. Control inputs (claim input, rubric, schemas, frozen config and non-research bindings) use control op only: frozen byte-bound non-research files, at most 3 complete control attempts per file per Dispatch. Log nonce and returned-text coverage apply; control_reads records attempts separately. Controls never count toward source_reads, complete_source_reads, retrieval_attempts or retained sources and never constitute claim evidence. Discovery query text, built only from the user question or claims, leaves the machine for the Wikipedia MediaWiki search API or Crossref REST API; each fetched URL receives a direct public HTTPS request. Never include vault or institutional material in discovery queries. No email, login, cookies, key, form submission or paywall bypass. source_date must be exactly 'YYYY-MM-DD' (a valid calendar date) or exactly 'unknown'. Never append a qualifier, filename, time or explanation to source_date. Preserve uncertainty in a separate source_date_note field, which the validator tolerates; a filename/HTTP modification date is not automatically a publication date. accessed_at and every timestamp must be ISO 8601 with a UTC offset, for example 2026-10-10T23:52:58+00:00 (Z also means UTC). Never use '2026-10-10 23:52:58 UTC'. Put any explanation in accessed_at_note or another note field. These formats apply to queries, retrievals, retained_sources, every claim evidence row and nested records. Literal valid claim row for this capability (illustration only; never retain it as task evidence): {"claim": "The fixture says Fixture evidence.", "claim_id": "EXAMPLE", "evidence": [{"accessed_at": "2026-10-10T23:52:58+00:00", "basis": "read_source", "content_sha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", "locator": "Fixture heading, sentence 1", "passage": "Fixture evidence.", "source": "https://example.org/fixture", "source_date": "unknown", "source_date_note": "Illustrative fixture; publication date unavailable."}]}. Exact source interface: <python-executable> <praxis-root>/services/praxis45/source_access.py <search|fetch|read|control|passage|find|hash> <source> --source-id <stable-whitespace-free-ID> --dispatch <your-own-Dispatch> --log '/SPECIALIZE/absolute/operations/{dispatch_id}.jsonl' --entry <bound-native-entry> [--cache <absolute-task-local-retained-directory/source>] [--start <character-offset> --length <1-to-4000>] [--backend mediawiki|crossref]. The frozen native entry supplies the Dispatch and exact log directory; --dispatch and --log must match it before any operation. The frozen log template replaces {dispatch_id} with the Dispatch from your injected preamble. One helper per provider tool call and one helper per code cell, never batched. Use the pinned Python and absolute helper path literally, one foreground invocation per tool call; do not combine source operations with other commands. Use fetch for public HTTPS originals or read for local originals, each once as a producer, retaining --cache bytes. Both extract full PDF/HTML text into the cache and print only counts and at most a 600-character head. Use passage by --start/--length or --query after a read/fetch/control/search for locators, find --query for case-insensitive whitespace-normalized matches with offsets (4,000 characters total), and hash for metadata; passage/find share a cap of 60 successful calls per Dispatch and are not reads; never inspect originals or caches with Read/Grep/Glob/Edit, Python, shell, or any other tool. Every log nonce must appear in at least one output and every output marker must exist in the log; global first-appearance order is not required. Recover a lost/truncated/reordered marker with source_access.py attest --nonce <existing-nonce> --dispatch <own-Dispatch> --log <exact-log> --entry <bound-native-entry> before worker_done; attestation is logged separately and counts as no operation. The verifier checks chain hashes, exact log-derived accounting and original bytes; repeated markers are harmless. Quote arguments any way the shell accepts. Source paths and URLs in receipt edits, self-checks and worker_done bodies never cause refusal. Native web tools invalidate the receipt by name. Record per-source returned-character coverage in operation_accounting.returned_characters from the log, and describe it in coverage_boundary: 60 successful inspections times at most 4,000 characters; complete read means machine extraction, not full model inspection. Only a retrieval row naming operation_nonce of a logged failed read/fetch attempt for that source is exempt from quote-was-returned, including tool_failed; operational_status on retained or claim evidence exempts nothing. A search_result_only row names operation_nonce of a successful search, source equal to its returned URL/DOI, and content_sha256 of the cached raw search response; passage is optional, but any passage/snippet must be returned title/snippet text for that result. Search-only evidence cannot support or refute. Every checkable claim must carry fetched or frozen read_source evidence; search-only-only claims refuse with a fetch-source reason. No-retained-evidence status remains unimplemented under the initial confined ruling; disclose the limitation.  Receipt passages must be at most 600 characters each and quote only text the helper returned. Every tool output, including nonce-bearing outputs, is checked after full nested JSON/string escape decoding and whitespace normalization: spans of retained/bound source text of at least 200 characters are counted; text covered by logged heads/passages/finds is allowed, including adjacent passages, persisted-output slices and receipt/self-check echoes. An output with at least 1000 characters of uncovered source text refuses, including separated windows. No nonce exemption. Argument/interpreter errors before an operation are harmless and may be corrected; attempted file/network operations are always logged, including failures. This is post hoc observability, not OS isolation or a mid-turn limiter: uncovered source text below 1000 characters per output, silent reads and consistent log/output forgery remain undetected. Before worker_done MUST run p4_run.py validate-output --capability praxis_native_evidence_research --file <required-output-path> --p4-config <frozen-config> --node <own-node> [--claim-input <frozen-claim-input>]; the bound entry supplies the Dispatch/provider/log. Standalone use additionally requires --dispatch-id <own-Dispatch> --agent <codex-or-claude> --operation-log <frozen-log-template> --dispatch-start <ISO-time>. Correct receipt errors locally; a forbidden past tool operation cannot be repaired by changing the receipt. Preserve failures and report failed if validation cannot pass. Discovery only through helper search with --backend mediawiki or crossref; query text only from the user question/claims. Honest Praxis User-Agent, no email/key/cookies/login, no silent fallback; failures consume attempts.
